headline: Maya understands the Android account boundary before trusting it with a conversation
overview: The actual Android app explains history, microphone timing, and account options without accepting credentials or creating persistent data.
payoff: Maya reaches account creation knowing what sign-in protects and exactly where the walkthrough stops.

scenes.title: Review the native Android sign-in
scenes.narrative: Maya sees Google and email sign-in, the reason authentication exists, and when microphone permission is requested.

scenes.title: Inspect account creation without submitting
scenes.narrative: The native form is visible, but no credentials or account write are executed.
